Claire (CS): quick synth from onboarding calls w/ three pilots — sharing common asks + verbatims. TL;DR: per-route cost visibility + toggle, embeddings staleness detection/ttl, easier feature export for PMs
Claire (CS): Accounts: BrightLane, NorthBay, HelioHealth. Highlights:
- BrightLane: "We need to turn off embeddings for low-priority routes to save costs."
- NorthBay: "Embeddings go stale after weekly uploads; can we auto-detect?"
- HelioHealth: "CSV export of customer asks + priority tags would help handoff to PMs."
Claire (CS): collected counts: 8 asks for per-route control, 6 mentions of embeddings freshness, 10 requests for a better export (some overlap).
Ravi (Product): useful, thanks. can you paste one sample export format you'd want? also any rough impact numbers (tokens/cost) per account?
Claire (CS): sample CSV columns: account, route, ask, severity (P0/P1/P2), customer_quote, date_reported, owner_suggestion
Claire (CS): cost sniff: BrightLane flagged 30% of tokens coming from a single experimental route — ~$1.2k/month extra on pilot. NorthBay embedding re-index jobs ~2x expected runtime because of repeated uploads.
Jon (Solutions): workaround we do today: tag routes w/ metadata and filter in support UI. We can add an export script to platform support tools to surface those tags ASAP. low lift.
Lena (Eng-ML): per-route toggle is harder for us than visibility — toggling affects batching/cache assumptions. If we add a toggle we need clear semantics: disable embedding compute for route X OR fall back to cached embedding?
Ravi (Product): ok — propose triage: 1) Add per-route visibility (dashboard export) — quick win. 2) Define embedding TTL / staleness detection as product requirement. 3) Longer term: per-route toggle (evaluate infra cost).
Claire (CS): agree. can we do dashboard export first. Customers keep asking for CSV to attach to their RFPs.
Integrations Bot: scheduled export job created: export-id=exp_20250323_01, will run daily and output to /s3/cs-exports/4950009876.csv :white_check_mark:
Jon (Solutions): i'll scope export script this week. ETA EOD Fri for a first pass.
Ravi (Product): can you add a RICE stub in our product board with these three items? i'll assign score once we have BrightLane numbers.
Claire (CS): attaching the three verbatim snippets below for the RICE card (paste):
"\"We need to turn off embeddings for low-priority routes to save costs.\" — BrightLane
"\"Embeddings go stale after weekly uploads; can we auto-detect?\" — NorthBay
"\"CSV export of customer asks + priority tags would help handoff to PMs.\" — HelioHealth
"
Lena (Eng-ML): for staleness detection, simple heuristic: last-modified vs. last-query frequency + embedding drift metric. we can prototype a flag in the indexer. low-medium effort.
Ravi (Product): perfect. Claire, can you confirm if any of these are blocking renewal conversations this quarter?
Claire (CS): BrightLane is leaning on cost numbers before committing to Dedicated next quarter — so yes conditional. NorthBay is okay but wants SLA for embeddings reliability. HelioHealth is not blocking renewal but influences roadmap asks.
Ravi (Product): thanks. next steps: Jon — export script; Lena — prototype staleness flag; Claire — collect exact cost delta from BrightLane (shared via DM) and add to RICE. I'll schedule a 30m triage Tues 10am PT. :calendar:
Claire (CS): noted. pinging BrightLane for cost confirmation now. :phone: 
Jon (Solutions): +1, will post the first export link in this thread when ready.
Integrations Bot: export completed: s3://cs-exports/4950009876.csv (contains 12 rows)
Claire (CS): got it. will review and attach to RICE card. :thumbsup:
